variants.text:
Hi Mintz Lights 👋 Emmanuel here. I saw your posts from late September — the Garissa load-out and the lighting builds — and went looking for the site on your page. mintzlights.com doesn't load anymore, so anyone who taps it just hits a dead end.

I build simple one-page sites for event and décor companies in Nairobi: gallery, packages, a WhatsApp button, M-Pesa deposit note. I can mock one up from your own photos and send you a screenshot — no charge to look.

Want me to? If it's not a priority, just say so and I won't come back. — Emmanuel

Hi Mintz Lights, Emmanuel here. Found you through your Facebook page — the setups you posted in the last week of September, the truck hire, the Evoria SPA styling in Ngara. You're clearly busy, and the work looks good.

One gap though: the website on your page, mintzlights.com, no longer resolves, and the directories still show your old P.O. Box and two different numbers. Someone who searches "event lighting Nairobi" lands on competitors with price pages instead of you.

What I build: one clean page — your best setups up top, three packages (lighting, décor/rustic furniture, truck + logistics), WhatsApp booking, M-Pesa deposit note, and 46 Kigwa Road with a map pin. Fast on mobile data.

I haven't built anything for you yet. Say the word and I'll do a free first draft using your own photos and send a screenshot right here. If it's not a priority, tell me and I'll stop. — Emmanuel

followups.text: Hi Emmanuel here, following up on the Mintz Lights site idea. Quick one: when someone taps the website link on your Facebook page today, it goes nowhere — that's the only reason I messaged. Should I put together that free draft, or park it? One word is fine.

Last note from me, promise. If a one-page site with your setups and a WhatsApp booking button is useful later — say before a busy wedding season — the offer stands and the draft is still free. If not, no problem at all, I'll leave it here. All the best with the Garissa-type jobs 🙏 — Emmanuel
